videos.title: What Happens If a Helicopter Engine Fails? (3D) 🚁
videos.description:
The engine dies mid-air. A freewheel clutch lets the rotor go, air rushes up through the blades, and the pilot glides down to a soft landing. It's called autorotation.
Helicopter or plane, which feels safer? 👇
